study.question: Can changing only fresh factor coordinates recover the rank88 context model's click quality under the frozen optimizer, making its reduced capacity useful relative to rank96 balanced, and is any recovery specific to rank rather than a uniform coordinate effect?
study.hypothesis: Observation: g2-r0062-context_budget_reference reproduced rank96 balanced AUC0.6675003890552496. Rank88 balanced reached0.6671251297972951 (loss0.0003752592579545); rank80 balanced reached0.6666047495443252 (loss0.0008956395109244). Output-heavy rank80 improved to0.6668938725427598 (+0.0002891229984346) but remained below the incumbent. Conversely, output-heavy rank96 in g2-r0060-factor_budget_96_output fell to0.667086629350575 (-0.0004137597046746), a sign reversal across ranks in separate rounds. Neither rank80 nor88 improved same-round model-only p50 (14.988/15.001ms versus14.922ms control), despite slightly lower inference wall times. The untested missing rank88/output-heavy cell can discriminate whether the intermediate capacity loss is partly coordinate-sensitive under the fixed training dynamics. At fixed rank both gauges represent the same initial context matrix and function class, but their optimizer, clipping and rounding trajectories need not agree. This is a bounded local hypothesis with counterevidence; an output-heavy benefit at rank80 does not predict transfer by itself. Freeze before new scoring: delta=0.0002 absolute click AUC. The only eligible candidate, context_gauge88_output, must have A88o-A96b >= -0.0002 against the contemporaneous balanced rank96 incumbent, and A88o >= 0.666553547526167 against the original frozen joint entry0.666753547526167. The historical current-incumbent floor is0.6673003890552496, but the paired new control governs reproduction and the paired difference. A failed control reproduction must be diagnosed before interpreting any new comparison; do not relax the margin or substitute the weaker entry comparator. A single-seed pass is provisional, never established noninferiority. If later host-authorized repetitions and paired user-cluster bootstrap are available, require the lower95% bound of the candidate-minus-incumbent AUC difference above -0.0002 and report each paired seed. Do not bootstrap individual impressions as independent users. Freeze utility cost gate separately: require measured dense/total parameter reduction and at least1% lower model-only p50 batch latency versus the matched rank96 balanced control, with p95 and total validation inference wall time each no worse than1%, and training wall time no worse than3%. Report every raw metric, allocated GPU/wall seconds, processed examples and peak memory. Parameter/MAC reduction or loading-dominated inference wall time alone is not a prediction-speed claim. Timing support requires repeated authorized matched receipts with median paired p50 ratio<=0.99 and consistent direction in at least two of three pairs; otherwise classify cost as unresolved or failed and retain the incumbent. No ad-hoc timing or repeated evaluation is authorized by this proposal; any later repetition uses the host interface and is budgeted. The small expected saving can legitimately fail this gate.
